sentences.text: Supplementary affidavit has been filed today, is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State as also perused the record.
3.

This application under Section 529 BNSS has been filed seeking direction to the court below for expeditious disposal of Case no. 1368 of 2022 arising out of Case Crime No.476 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act and Section 3/4 Muslim Women (Prevention of Marriage Act), Police Station Goverdhan, District Mathura pending before Civil Judge (Junior Division), Fast Track Court (Offence against Women) Judicial Magistrate, Mathura within a shortest span of time as fixed by this Court.

entities.text: Civil Judge (Junior Division), Fast Track Court (Offence against Women) Judicial Magistrate, Mathura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that earlier the appellant has approached this Court by filing Application u/s 482 No.31891 of 2023 (Ashu vs. State of U.P. and 5 others) and this Court vide order dated 29.08.2024 while disposing of the same directed the court below to decide the aforesaid case without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, preferably within a period of ten months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order.

entities.text: Ashu vs. State of U.P. and 5 others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that till now the aforesaid case has not been decided as yet.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court concerned to decide the aforesaid case expeditiously in compliance of order dated 29.09.2024 passed by this Court, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties.

(Shekhar Kumar Yadav,J.) September 3, 2025 Ajeet  Ashu vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150699645/
